recipes.name: Egg fried rice
recipes.method_note: Cold, day-old rice works best. Fresh rice goes sticky.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} in 600 ml water, covered, 12 minutes.
Spread it on a tray to cool.
steps.note: Steaming hot rice will clump in the pan.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} in a bowl.
Put a wide pan on a high heat with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Pour in the egg. Scramble 1 minute. Lift it out.
Add the garlic. Stir 30 seconds.
Add the rice and {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Fry 4 minutes.
Put the egg back. Add {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Scatter the spring onions over.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable stir fry
recipes.method_note: Chop everything before the pan goes on. It cooks in six minutes.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} thinly.
Cut {{ing:pepper-bell}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:broccoli-head}} into small pieces.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:honey}} in a cup.
Boil {{ing:egg-noodles-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Put a wide pan on a high heat with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry the chicken 4 minutes, until white through.
Add the vegetables. Fry 3 minutes.
steps.note: They should still have a bite.

steps.instruction: Add the garlic and ginger. Stir 30 seconds.
Add the sauce and the drained noodles. Toss 1 minute.
Press {{ing:tofu-firm}} between two plates for 15 minutes.
steps.note: Drier tofu crisps instead of steaming.

steps.instruction: Cut it into cubes and toss in {{ing:cornflour}}.
Cut {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:pineapple}} into chunks.
Mix {{ing:tomato-ketchup}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} in 600 ml water, covered, 12 minutes.
Fry the tofu in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes, until golden.
Lift it out. Fry the peppers 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple and the sauce. Simmer 3 minutes.
Put the tofu back and turn to coat.

recipes.name: Chilli and peanut chicken, kung pao style
recipes.method_note: Sweet, sour and gently hot. Cut everything before the pan goes on: it cooks fast.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Toss with {{ing:cornflour}} and 1 tablespoon of the soy.
Mix the rest of {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:rice-vinegar}} and {{ing:honey}} with 3 tablespoons of water.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:chilli-fresh}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wok on a high heat. Fry the chicken 6 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, chilli and pepper. Stir-fry 2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce. Bubble 1 minute, until glossy.
Stir in {{ing:peanuts}} and the spring onion. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Ginger and spring onion fish
recipes.method_note: Very gentle cooking. The fish is done when it flakes at the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Cut {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:spring-onion}} into thin strips.
Put {{ing:cod-fillet}} on a plate that fits in a large pan with a lid.
Scatter half the ginger over. Stand the plate on a trivet or upturned bowl in the pan.
Add 3 cm of boiling water. Cover. Steam 8 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Steam {{ing:pak-choi}} alongside for the last 3 minutes.
Top the fish with the rest of the ginger and the spring onion.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}} until smoking. Pour over the fish.
steps.note: It sizzles. That cooks the ginger and onion.

steps.instruction: Spoon {{ing:soy-sauce}} over. Serve with the rice and greens.
